profileEvidence.summary: Reserved with strangers and quietly affectionate with familiar people, Levriero Meridionale are described by conservation breeder Flaviano Bruno as sensitive hounds closely attached to their household or pack. This southern Italian working sighthound was selected for hunting hares by sight, combining swift pursuit with sustained effort.
